description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. Did Jesus have an advantage over us when he was here on earth? Since he could read people's thoughts and foresee their actions.
2. The testimony of Jesus does it only applies to E. White/Spirit of Prophecy or does this have a broader view. (Rev 19:10, Rev 12:17 and Isa 8:20)
.
.
.

Only on SUMtv.org!
